speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I am Dr. Agent; to begin our assessment of this newborn, please tell me your baby's gestational age and if they were born via vaginal delivery or C-section.

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, female. The patient is a 3000-g (6.6-lb) female newborn delivered at term to a 23-year-old primigravida mother. The mother reports having had no prenatal care, and immunization records for the newborn are not available.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that history. Since the mother had no prenatal care and immunizations are unavailable, I need to know if the newborn has received any vaccines so far. Additionally, has the baby exhibited any signs of jaundice, cough, difficulty breathing, or poor feeding?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Continuous heart murmur. I also have Bluish macules on the skin that do not blanch with pressure, Cloudy lenses in both eyes noticed upon examination, Failure to pass auditory screening tests.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Rubella Syndrome.

The combination of a continuous heart murmur, non-blanching purpuric skin lesions, cataracts, and sensorineural deafness in an unvaccinated infant is classic for this condition.
